description: This file defines the ICapture interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, including a nested IStore interface. It declares methods related to capturing images and storing them, likely used for screen capturing or similar functionalities in the application.

classes.name: ICapture
classes.description: An interface for capturing images or screens, with a method to retrieve the interface instance and to perform capture operations.

classes.name: ICapture::IStore
classes.description: An interface for storing captured image data, with a method to process raw buffer data into a specific pixel format.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the capture device or instance.

methods.name: Capture
methods.description: Performs a capture operation using the provided storage method.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns an instance of the ICapture interface.
